commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, and the keystone may matter to that. 2. Go to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in the Kothringi Greathouse; the marker is on Hums-the-Long-Note. 3. I can talk to Hums-the-Long-Note and ask for the elder, then show the keystone. I can also look around Toklea. No other choice is visible yet. 4. I do not know what the Eye is exactly, or what the keystone does. I can ask the elder and the Chime-Keepers.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment: her family grave-stake from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha. 2. Go to Zul-Etha (south-east from Mir-Xal quay), get the grave-stake from the Drowned Chest, bring it back. 3. Fight the crocodiles and old bull (from a roof or by arrows), calm them with Illusion, or swim under unseen. As a fighter I favour fighting. 4. I do not know where exactly Mir-Xal is, though the go command should take me to the marker. I do not know what the keystone is yet; she will tell after.
take Carved Grave-Stake from Drowned Chest
